description: This Viet Nam energy-system deposit provides annual gross regional domestic product for 63 provinces from 2010 to 2016. Its own page says the tables separate four economic sectors and report both 2010-price and current-price values, collected from a General Statistics Office library. Zenodo lists a public 521 MB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Provincial GRDP can help calibrate regional energy, transport or infrastructure-investment demand assumptions. It is a historical economic statistic, not a forecast or direct measure of asset use. The archive is unusually large for a few annual tables, and the public page does not explain its internal format, sector codes or currency units. Upstream statistical-source rights and any revisions need checking separately. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this 63-province collection. The ZIP was not downloaded, so workbook contents and numeric consistency remain unverified.
name: Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP) data of 63 provinces in Vietnam from 2010 to 2016
